title: Investigating therapeutic potential of Evodiamine by identifying differentially expressed genes in cisplatin resistance non-small cell lung cancer.
authors: Patra, Sambit Kumar; Pradhan, Sambit Kumar; Ansari, Zahid Alim; Biswal, Bijesh Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吴茱萸碱逆转肺癌顺铂耐药，涉及ZEB2等基因表达与分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Cisplatin resistance poses a significant barrier to effective chemotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer, often driven by epithelial-mesenchymal transition regulators such as ZEB2. In this study, we explored the therapeutic potential of Evodiamine (Evo), a natural alkaloid derived from Evodia rutaecarpa, to overcome cisplatin resistance in A549 lung cancer cells. Using MTT assay, we evaluated the cytotoxic effects of Evo on both A549 parental and A549 cisplatin-resistant(A549CR) cells (IC-50 4 microM & 2 microM respectively), observing a dose-dependent reduction in cell viability. Quantitative real-time PCR analysis revealed that Evo treatment significantly downregulated ZEB2 expression along with key drug-resistance genes, suggesting its role in reversing the resistant phenotype. In silico molecular docking and network analysis further supported strong binding interactions between Evo and ZEB2, TGM2, MMP1, CD24, PDK4, highlighting its potential as a direct inhibitor. By further evaluating anti-proliferative, anti-migratory property with apoptotic inducing potential of Evo, we found there is a significant effect on A549 and A549CR cells. Together, these findings demonstrate that ZEB-2 can be an effective target of Evo mediating cisplatin resistance pathways and sensitize resistant lung cancer cells to cisplatin, providing a promising combinatorial therapeutic strategy to enhance NSCLC treatment efficacy.
abstract_zh: 顺铂耐药对非小细胞肺癌的有效化疗构成重大障碍，通常由上皮-间质转化调节因子如ZEB2驱动。在本研究中，我们探讨了从吴茱萸中提取的天然生物碱——吴茱萸碱（Evodiamine, Evo）在克服A549肺癌细胞顺铂耐药方面的治疗潜力。通过MTT实验，我们评估了Evo对A549亲本细胞和A549顺铂耐药（A549CR）细胞的细胞毒性效应（IC-50分别为4微摩尔和2微摩尔），观察到细胞活力呈剂量依赖性降低。实时定量PCR分析显示，Evo处理显著下调ZEB2表达及关键耐药基因，提示其在逆转耐药表型中的作用。计算机分子对接和网络分析进一步支持Evo与ZEB2、TGM2、MMP1、CD24、PDK4之间的强结合相互作用，突显其作为直接抑制剂的潜力。通过进一步评估Evo的抗增殖、抗迁移特性及凋亡诱导潜力，我们发现其对A549和A549CR细胞有显著影响。综合这些发现，表明ZEB2可作为Evo介导顺铂耐药途径的有效靶点，并使耐药肺癌细胞对顺铂敏感，为增强非小细胞肺癌治疗效果提供了一种有前景的联合治疗策略。
